summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 4, 2026 the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Montana approved its Section 363 purchase of specified Montana Tunnels Mining assets under an August 21, 2026 APA with Montana Goldfields. At initial closing, the company released about $28.58 million from escrow for creditor obligations, receiving a non-interest-bearing senior secured note, general security agreement, guaranty, pledge and mortgage. Final closing conditions and the November 30, 2026 note maturity are the key remaining items to monitor.
